subject: general
question: Who among the following is the author of the Hindi poetry book 'Chheelatey Hue Apne Ko'?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Nand Kishore Acharya.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nand Kishore Acharya **__

 __
 
• **He awarded the Sahitya Akademi Award 2019 in Hindi Literature.**
 
• **He receives recognition for his book of Hindi poetry, 'Chheelatey Hue Apne Ko'. Therefore, Nand Kishore Acharya is the author of the Hindi poetry book 'Chheelatey Hue Apne Ko. Hence, Option 1 is correct.**
 
• Nand Kishore Acharya was born in Bikaner, Rajasthan.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Sahitya Akademi__

 __
 
• The **Sahitya Akademi**, **India's National Academy of Letters,** is an organization dedicated to the promotion of literature in the languages of India.
 
• **Founded on 12 March 1954,** it is supported by, though independent of, the **Indian government.**
 
• Its office is located in Rabindra Bhavan near Mandi House in Delhi.
 
• It presents the annual Sahitya Akademi Award of **Rs. 100,000 **(approx. USD 1,500 (in the year 2013)) in each of the 24 languages it supports, as well as the Sahitya Akademi Fellowship for lifetime achievement.
 
 
 
• **Sahitya Akademi Award 2021**__
 
 
• **On December 30, 2021, the Sahitya Akademi Award 2021 was given for literary works in 20 Indian languages. Namita Gokhale received the award for her novel ‘Things to Leave Behind’ and Anuradha Sarma Pujari for her Assamese novel ‘Iyat Ekhan Aaronya Asil’.**
 
• Along with the Sahitya Akademi Awards, Yuva Puraskar and Bal Sahitya Puraskar for 2021 were also announced. Awards in Gujarati, Maithili,- Manipuri & Urdu languages will be announced at a later date.
